entity.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)

lineage.description: IOM/DTM conducted direct observational assessments across multiple rounds (June and September 2022) to track displacement and return movements in Northeast Nigeria's BAY States. Data was collected through field surveys and compiled into separate datasets for IDPs and returnees by assessment round.
